description:
Open an escrow between payer and payee. amount_minor is a positive
    integer in minor units (cents). The platform fee is computed and FROZEN at
    open (ceil bps). Returns the escrow_id (state OPEN). RETRY-SAFE: pass
    open_ref=<your job id> and a replayed open returns the ORIGINAL escrow
    (duplicate=true) instead of minting another one (E10).

amount_minor.description: Escrow amount in minor units (cents), a positive whole number.
amount_minor.title: Amount Minor

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, for example USD.
currency.title: Currency

fee_bps.description: Optional. Platform fee in basis points; fixed when the escrow opens.
fee_bps.title: Fee Bps

open_ref.description: Optional but recommended. Your job id; repeating it returns the same escrow.
open_ref.title: Open Ref

payee.description: Agent id of the party paid on release.
payee.title: Payee

payer.description: Agent id of the party paying into escrow.
payer.title: Payer

terms.description: Optional. The agreed deliverable, in words or as a reference.
terms.title: Terms

name: open_escrow
title: Open escrow
